Unlock Fire Attack, Shield & Speed Boost in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D

🎮 Gameyard Studio • 📅 November 21, 2026 • ⏱ 5 min read

Unleash the primal fury within! The latest combat update for Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D introduces game-changing Special Powers and an expansive catalog of Custom Skins. Download the update on the Google Play Store and dominate every wilderness confrontation with unmatched elemental force.

Mastering the 3 New Special Powers

Engaging rival apex predators requires more than basic claw swipes. Equip and trigger these three dynamic combat powers in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D to turn unwinnable fights into decisive victories:

🔥 1. Fire Attack (Blazing Claws & Bites)

Ignite your physical strikes with scorching flame energy. Each successful hit deals immediate burst damage and leaves enemies suffering from ongoing burn status effects over 5 seconds. Perfect for melting high-health boss bears and massive crocodiles.

🛡️ 2. Primal Shield (Invulnerability Barrier)

Project a hardened mystical forcefield around your beast. The shield absorbs up to 75% of incoming kinetic damage for 8 seconds, allowing you to survive lethal counter-strikes and break out of predatory pins during chaotic den defense sieges.

⚡ 3. Speed Boost (Lightning Reflexes)

Supercharge your muscular velocity. Activates a 50% sprint boost with zero stamina depletion for a short burst. Indispensable for chasing down swift prey or escaping an overwhelming pack of enemy carnivores.

Unlocking Rare & Mythical Skins

Transform the appearance of your Wolf, Tiger, Panther, Lion, Bear, and Crocodile. From bioluminescent phantom markings and volcanic ember pelts to frozen frost hides, skins in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D reflect your status as the reigning supreme predator.

Equip Special Powers & Stand Out

Unleash Fire Attacks and show off mythical skins in Wild Animal Survival Sim 3D. Download free on Google Play today!
